Book of Utilities: utilities for working with data

Source: R/book.of.utilities.R
book.of.utilities.Rd

book.of.utilities seeks to facilitate execution of those repetitive, ad-hoc tasks often encountered during data processing.

The following functional chapters are covered in book.of.utilities:

Chapter 1 - Calculators

FunctionSynopsis
calc.meansCalculates mean variants for vectors and tabular inputs.
calc.zero_meanCenters values at zero by subtracting the mean.
calc.rmsComputes root-mean-square of numeric input.
calc.harmonic_meanComputes harmonic mean of numeric input.
calc.geo_meanComputes geometric mean of numeric input.
ratioComputes ratio-based transforms for numeric input.
ranking.algorithmAssigns rank values using threshold mapping logic.
range_diffReturns inclusive range width (max minus min).
odds2probsConverts odds representations to probabilities.

Chapter 2 - Counters

FunctionSynopsis
count_cyclesGenerates a cycle counter from a logical condition vector.
factor_intComputes integer factors for numeric inputs.
radixConverts numeric representations across radix bases.
factor.intAlias for factor_int.
count.cyclesAlias for count_cycles.

Chapter 3 - Miscellaneous

FunctionSynopsis
log_noteAppends timestamped note text to file or console.
vlogicalPerforms vectorized pattern matching for one or more patterns.
polyname2origRewrites polynomial feature names to source-variable form.
gen_primesGenerates prime numbers within a supplied domain.
call_recursionApplies a function repeatedly while a test condition is true.
checksumCompares an object digest to an expected hash value.
gen.primesAlias for gen_primes.
call.recursionAlias for call_recursion.

Chapter 4 - Custom Operators

FunctionSynopsis
%bin%Bins numeric values to fixed intervals using modulo subtraction.
%><%Wrapper for test_between interval logic.
%tf%Creates paired true/false value choices.
%?%Applies if-then-else selection using logical conditions.
%??%Performs correlated row-wise conditional selection.
%if_na_empty%Replaces NA or empty values from another object.
test_betweenTests whether ranges/values are between target ranges.

Chapter 5 - Object Management

FunctionSynopsis
distinct.listReturns first-level unique list elements.
enlistConverts vectors to named lists.
get.object_sizesRecursively reports object sizes with depth information.
